notes.title: Dustoria Update V1.0.2
notes.notes:
📸 Added option to enter Photo Mode after finishing the game

🐞 Minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Dustoria Demo Small Update
notes.notes:
Here’s what’s new in the latest patch:



🔧 Gameplay & Balance

🌿 If survival stats are low, the system now prioritizes offering survival-related buildings.

🏗️ Bug Fixes

🔋 Battery building now has a proper collider.

📈 Fixed an issue where score popups would get stuck above buildings if you placed a building right as you leveled up

🈶Fixed missing Chinese characters in UI.

🎮 Tutorial now properly shows the controls.

📷 Fixed some profile pictures not loading in the Steam leaderboard.



Thanks for playing and sharing feedback – it means a lot! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Dustoria Demo Small Update
notes.notes:
Another day, another update! Here’s what’s new in the latest demo patch:



🐧 Linux support is now live!

🏆 Steam Leaderboards are in – compete for the top spot!

🏝️ Island parts no longer get negative points from nearby power-generating buildings

🎵 Fixed overlapping music when returning to the main menu

📐 Tutorial visuals now display correctly on all resolutions



Test it out and let us know if you break something (or if we did ːsteamsadː)

notes.title: Dustoria Demo Small Update
notes.notes:
🌐 Chinese language support is now available!
 💻 Mac support has been added!

notes.title: Dustoria Demo Small Update
notes.notes:
Pause Menu Added! Take a break anytime with the new in-game menu.
Card Selection Bug Fixed: You can no longer accidentally select another card while placing a building.
Performance Improvements: Optimized the card generation code for better efficiency.
